meta.name: british-common-names
meta.provenance: British English crop names curated from Royal Horticultural Society grow-your-own guides; per-row citations. Only crops present in crop-profiles.json where British usage differs from the American name.
notes: Locale tags are BCP 47 language-REGION. Untagged names in the catalog remain universal.
Rocket, coriander, swede, and mangetout are omitted because their crops are not in the catalog yet; add rows when the crops land.
